payload.edited_body:
Dear Professor Example,

I am Avery Reed at the Example University and Example Research Group. With Blaire Mercer, I build trureturing (https://github.com/the-omega-institute/trureturing), an AI orchestration system that connects knowledge (https://www.trureturing.org/). The result came out of trureturing and was verified in Lean.

The calculation gives 5.
We'd welcome corrections, and we'd be glad to look at it together if you're interested.

More broadly, we are building a connected knowledge graph of mathematics (our Mathematical Atlas: https://www.trureturing.org/atlas) with an open community, pairing human intuition with AI for searching, checking, and formalizing, through open mathematics initiatives.

If you'd like to try the system behind the result above, we recently launched Mathesis (https://mathesis.example.invalid/). You may submit a short note or a conjecture bothering you, and our review pipeline maps it against existing formal libraries to suggest further directions and formalization targets and assigns a DOI to protect your priority and authorship.

Best regards,
Avery and Blaire
Example University; Example Research Group
